result.description: Work management platform for boards, items, workflows, CRM and project tracking, with a GraphQL platform API.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 auth-code for apps (legacy flow: non-expiring tokens, no refresh; newer OAuth 2.1 with refresh tokens announced). Personal V2 API token for own-account use, sent in Authorization header.
result.access_detail: Free developer account lets anyone create an app and get OAuth credentials and a personal token. Docs do not state plan restrictions or a review requirement for private use. Marketplace listing for public apps likely needs review, not verified in the docs read.
result.api_notes: GraphQL endpoint https://api.monday.com/v2. It covers boards, items, columns, users, teams, workspaces, docs, updates, webhooks, tags and notifications. Scoped OAuth permissions are available. Breadth is inferred from the scope list. I did not count endpoints.

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
Tokens do not expire and are valid until the user uninstalls your app.
If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account
OAuth scopes define what your app can and cannot do.
The monday apps MCP uses your existing API token for authentication.
